rules.summary: Items listed as clearance (sold as-is, at a disclosed markdown) are not eligible for refund. This is a listing-time fact, not a judgment call.
Refund requests must be submitted within 30 days of the order date. Requests outside this window are denied regardless of reason.
Refund requests for orders totaling more than $500 always require human review before being finalized, regardless of how eligible the request otherwise looks.
Items with a verified issue (damaged in transit, wrong item shipped, or missing item) are eligible for refund approval, subject to AI-assisted review of the customer's account of what happened.

Requests where the customer's claim contradicts verified order/item facts (e.g. claiming an item arrived damaged when no issue is on file, or claiming non-delivery when the order status shows delivered), or where a customer has filed repeated requests in a short window, are escalated for human review rather than auto-decided.
